name: @offprompt/install
description: Every way offprompt reaches an agent: the plugin directory, the scripts that install it, and the config for projects that carry the bundle themselves.

scripts.package: pnpm --filter offprompt build && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.agents: pnpm --filter offprompt build && node scripts/build.mjs && node dist/offprompt-install.mjs
